# Psalm 112 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 112:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Mighty in-the-land will-be his-seed; the-generation-of the-upright will-be-blessed.
- **LOGOS:** His offspring will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
- **PNEUMA:** Their children will be powerful in the land; the descendants of the godly will be blessed.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
